question: Fiat money ki value kahan se aati hai?
essence: Fiat money government authority aur public trust par tikta hai, gold backing ya material value par nahi.
answer: Fiat money paper ya digital numbers ho sakta hai; uski monetary value material ki intrinsic value se nahi aati. Yeh gold ya silver jaise commodities se backed nahi hota. Government-issued system mein central banks production control karte hain; public ka government par faith iski value ka base hai. Zaroorat par aur money issue kiya ja sakta hai. [p004]
deep_dive: 'Easily printed' ko gold-backed system ke contrast mein samjhein: extra issuance ke liye gold backing ki condition nahi hai. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki paper khud valuable commodity ban gaya. Source ki final characteristic 'Highly regu' par cut hai; uska complete statement available nahi. [p004]
